meta.title: About - Craftland Hub
meta.description: Learn about Craftland Hub, a community-driven platform for Free Fire custom maps.

hero.title: About
hero.subtitle: Your ultimate destination for discovering, sharing, and rating custom Craftland maps for the Free Fire community. Built by players, for players.

mission.title: Empowering the Craftland Community
mission.paragraph1: Craftland Hub was created to foster a vibrant community of map creators and players in the Free Fire ecosystem. We believe that custom maps are the heart of what makes Craftland special, and our platform serves as a bridge between talented creators and enthusiastic players.
mission.paragraph2: Our goal is to provide a safe, organized, and engaging space where the community can discover new experiences, share their creations, and build lasting connections through the shared love of custom Craftland maps.

features.title: Everything You Need
features.subtitle: Discover the features that make Craftland Hub the go-to platform for custom map enthusiasts

discovery.title: Map Discovery
discovery.description: Browse through thousands of user-created maps across multiple categories, from action-packed battles to creative challenges. Find your next favorite map with ease.

community.title: Community Driven
community.description: Join a thriving community of creators and players. Share your maps, rate others, and connect with fellow enthusiasts who share your passion.

quality.title: Quality Assurance
quality.description: Every map goes through community review and rating system to ensure quality and fair play for all users. Trust in our community's judgment.

stats.title: Growing Together
stats.subtitle: Our community is growing stronger every day, creating amazing experiences for Free Fire players worldwide

cta.title: Ready to Start Your Journey?
cta.subtitle: Whether you're a seasoned map creator or just discovering the world of custom Craftland maps, there's a place for you in our community. Start exploring, creating, and connecting today!
